general_theorem.name: FIXED_SUPPORT_SIGNED_TRANSPORT_DISCOVERY
general_theorem.parameter: K is a fixed constant independent of input size
algorithm: Given sibling CNFs A and B on variable universe V, enumerate support sizes s=0..K in deterministic order.
Enumerate every subset S subseteq V with |S|=s.
Enumerate every permutation rho of S and every sign vector epsilon in {+1,-1}^S; extend pi to V by pi(v)=epsilon(v)*rho(v) on S and pi(v)=v outside S.
For each candidate pi, verify B->A transport by checking for every C in A whether some D in B satisfies D subseteq pi(C). Also check the reverse orientation A->B.
On the first valid transport, safely delete the transported-from sibling and retain the transported-to sibling. If no candidate exists, return NO_RULE_APPLICABLE rather than an answer.
general_theorem.candidate_count_bound: sum_{s=0}^K binom(n,s) s! 2^s <= c_K n^K for fixed K
general_theorem.verification_cost_per_candidate: O(m_A*m_B*w) by direct clause-subsumption checking, where w is maximum encoded clause width
general_theorem.total_discovery_bound: O(n^K * m_A * m_B * w) up to a constant depending only on fixed K
general_theorem.soundness: Every accepted candidate is sound by the R44BP signed-subsumption model-transport theorem.
general_theorem.completeness_for_class: If either sibling direction admits a signed transport whose support size is at most K, exhaustive bounded-support enumeration finds one.
general_theorem.failure_semantics: NO_RULE_APPLICABLE is not UNSAT and carries no theorem authority beyond absence of this fixed-support certificate class.

K5_instantiation.R44AS_effect: The deterministic K=5 algorithm must enumerate and accept a valid B=G[x2=true] -> A=G[x2=false] certificate, after which B is safely deleted and maxdef moves 2->1.

infinite_disjoint_lift.construction: For arbitrary k>=1, take k variable-disjoint renamed copies of the R44AS base formula and branch on the distinguished x2 variable of one chosen copy.
infinite_disjoint_lift.why_rank_is_additive: Every clause subset decomposes uniquely across variable-disjoint components and deficiency adds; maximizing independently in each component gives additivity of maximal deficiency.
infinite_disjoint_lift.transport: Use the same support-5 signed permutation inside the distinguished copy and identity on every variable of all other copies. Common outside-copy clauses map to themselves, while distinguished-copy clauses use the R44BP witnesses.
infinite_disjoint_lift.discovery: K5_SIGNED_TRANSPORT_DISCOVER_DELETE_V1 enumerates this global signed permutation because its non-identity support is still exactly five variables, independent of k.
infinite_disjoint_lift.safe_delete_effect: For every k, one sibling is safely deleted and the retained state has rank 2k-1.
infinite_disjoint_lift.unbounded_size_consequence: There is an infinite family of arbitrarily large sibling states for which a fixed deterministic polynomial-time transport-discovery rule performs exact destructive rank descent.

r44bd_accounting.polynomial_state_overhead: YES__enumeration uses polynomial counters plus one candidate permutation/certificate
r44bd_accounting.witness_lifting: POLYNOMIAL__apply signed permutation when needed, then restore branch pivot

next_exact_question: Does every maxdef-critical sibling pair admit a bounded-support signed transport for one universal constant K, or can one construct an exact critical family whose minimum signed-transport support grows unboundedly or has no signed transport at all?
